HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: Two Heathen children went exploring after lunch and have not come back, and it is getting dark.

description_variants.description: Two Isolan children went exploring after lunch and have not come back, and it is getting dark.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) went off exploring after lunch and haven't come back. It's getting dark. (third) goes looking.

text_only.reason: health or an injury talked about in the story; the outcome's own effects are the draft's -- story only

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (third) finds them at the bottom of a gully, muddy, scraped and very glad to be found. One of them has a twisted ankle. (third) carries (subject.him/her) home on (third.his/her) back the whole way.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: Everyone turns out with torches. The children are found within the hour, hiding under a fallen tree from a noise that turns out to be a very large frog. They are scolded, hugged and fed, in that order.
